title: gui tests: routing-levels 'webkit zh: a group names the reasoning levels' times out at its 5s wait for the no-level message under load
body:
`internal/gui/tests/routing-levels.test.cjs` 'webkit zh: a group names the reasoning levels agents are offered' failed once in a run of every `*routing*.test.cjs` plus i18n-keys (1420 tests, 55 red, load average 23 to 34 from other sessions):

```
not ok 604 - webkit zh: a group names the reasoning levels agents are offered
  duration_ms: 24005.680417
  error: 'page.waitForFunction: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.'
  name: 'TimeoutError'
  stack: |-
    TestContext.<anonymous> (internal/gui/tests/routing-levels.test.cjs:136:18)
```

Line 136 waits 5s for the "no level" message after Save with both chips cleared:
`await page.waitForFunction((s) => document.documentElement.innerText.includes(s), w.none);`

Run alone, the file passes 4 of 4 both at a3232e3e1 (origin/main) and with the #3164 wire change on top. So this is a 5s bar that a loaded machine misses, not a wrong state. The fix is room on the wait (or waiting on the save's own result), per the code standards' timing rule.

Found while testing the #3164 follow-up; not taking it.
